key_insight: Oxygen alters AlTi melt surface tension in a strongly composition-dependent way and suppresses aluminum surface segregation.
engineering_relevance: Controlling oxygen and alloy composition may help tune interfacial behavior in molten AlTi processing.
method: Molecular dynamics simulations using a machine-learned interaction potential.
Element-resolved density profiles to assess interfacial enrichment and segregation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports oxygen enrichment near the interface, reduced aluminum segregation, and comparison of surface-tension results with microgravity experiments.
watch_item: Prior potential validation focused on bulk melts; the abstract does not quantify accuracy for oxygen-containing interfaces.
paper_title: The effect of oxygen on the surface tension of AlTi metallic alloys
